summary: Corteva filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 confirming completion on October 1, 2026 of its separation of the seed operating segment into an independent public company, Vylor Inc. The Separation was effected via a pro rata distribution of all Vylor common shares to Corteva common holders of record as of the close of business September 24, 2026; no price, premium or cash consideration applies. Vylor common stock is expected to begin regular-way NYSE trading under symbol VYLR on October 1, 2026. No advisor, board recommendation or break fee was disclosed. Watch post-distribution index flows, Vylor share overhang from holders selling spinco stock, and any retained-stake or transition-service disclosures.
